title: Decide source-backed or assisted route for U-VEND Manual Nos
purpose: Avoid repeating failed checkbox/list routes; inspect a source-backed, assisted or stronger BC UI route before any U-VEND Manual Nos write.

smartDecision.whyNow: D2F proved BC context and U-VEND filter syntax, but did not prove a safe Manual Nos write or active reopen state.
smartDecision.risk: Repeating visual checkbox clicks can change the wrong value or create false proof.
smartDecision.fallback: If no stronger route is found, park vendor creation and choose another Foundation dependency.
smartDecision.screenshotProof: Screenshots must show Page 456, U-VEND filter, relevant action/field route and why it is or is not safe.
smartDecision.bookExplanation: The book may explain Manual Nos. as a prerequisite for readable manual vendor numbers, but must not claim vendor readiness until the setup is proven.

entryCriteria: D2F result exists and is blocked without setup change.
No vendor creation retry is attempted before Manual Nos. is proven active.
stopIf: The active instance is not playthru.
The active company is not UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Any route asks to create master data or documents.
Any route requires toggling U-VEND before a stronger proof path is documented.
A dialog asks to save unrelated setup, post, preview, delete or switch company.
acceptanceCriteria: A source-backed, assisted or stronger route decision is documented.
Failed D2/D2B/D2E/D2F routes are not repeated.
No setup, master data, document, Preview Posting or Posting occurs.
The next case is either a safe U-VEND write gate or a different Foundation dependency with rationale.
